TextBlock.Text: THE SOUTHERN ROUTE, mid-morning. WILKINS 03, the A319 airlink to Wilkins Aerodrome, lost contact on the Hobart-Casey track at 0352 and put down on the water eighteen minutes later. Her EPIRB ran for forty minutes and then stopped, which is what happens when somebody switches it off. A longliner heard it and reported it. A factory trawler from the fleet that shadowed the Storm Bay convoy was closer, and the trawler is now holding position sixty miles west of the datum, answering nobody, with the research trawler NAN HAI 27 steaming to meet her. You have your escort group with the Seahawk and the Poseidon you brought, and SENTRY 21 high to the south. Six contacts are in the search box: longliners, a factory trawler that is only fishing, the expedition cruise ship POLAR HORIZON southbound, a whale, and the one that matters. Classify her and put your flagship within three miles of her. Your weapons are tight, and a shot at the wrong hull is a shot at the crew.
Commodore Alex Mercer; Wing Commander Daniel Ward for the search plan

WILKINS 03 put down on the water at 0410 and her crew are alive: the EPIRB says so and so does the longliner that heard it. Something recovered them before we could, and it is not steaming for Hobart. Find it among the traffic, classify it, and put a ship alongside. Do not fire at anything on the water today - the people we want are on one of those decks.

Datum: Classify the trawler holding the crew, then put your flagship within three miles of her Neutrals: Harm no fishing boat, cruise ship or whale Flagship: Bring your flagship out intact Collector: Classify Nan Hai 27 as well

Your escort group with one MH-60R and one P-8A if requisitioned, one MQ-4C Triton overhead. Neutral: two longliners, a factory trawler, an expedition cruise ship, a whale. Opposing: the trawler holding the crew, unarmed; the research trawler Nan Hai 27 closing to meet her.
70 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.
Destroying a neutral contact ends the operation in failure. Identify before you shoot.
U.S. Navy 2027 Capabilities mod, Boeing P-8 Poseidon, Humpback Whale, the base game, this pack.
